title: 进化心理学反思
text: 今天的阳光透过窗棂，照亮了书桌上关于生物决定论的学术著作。进化心理学试图将人类行为归结为自然选择的产物。该领域主张心理机制在漫长的演化过程中被固化，旨在提高生存率。然而，这种还原论倾向引发了广泛争论。批评者认为其过度依赖不可验证的假设。这种推演方式常被指责为事后合理化。它将复杂的社会现象简化为基因驱动的本能。文化多样性在此时被严重低估。人类具备极强的神经可塑性。环境因素对认知结构的塑造作用不可忽视。社会建构论强调个体在特定语境下的动态演变。基因仅提供基础框架，而非绝对指令。许多所谓的普适性行为模式缺乏严谨实证。样本选择偏差导致结论具有误导性。这种决定论容易被误用以正当化性别偏见。它忽略了意识在决策过程中的主导地位。道德选择并非单纯追求繁殖成功。文明的进步体现了对原始冲动的超越。认知科学应当整合多维度的视角。生物学基础与社会文化影响互为表里。单一维度的解释无法涵盖人类精神世界的深邃。学术界需警惕过度简化复杂系统的倾向。严谨的实证研究应当剔除主观臆断。只有在跨学科对话中，我们才能接近真相。这种反思有助于构建更全面的心理学范式。

questions.prompt: According to critics mentioned in the text, what is a major problem with evolutionary psychology's reasoning?
options: It relies too heavily on assumptions that cannot be verified
It relies too heavily on large-scale controlled experiments
It completely ignores the theory of natural selection
It has been unanimously accepted without any criticism

questions.prompt: What does the text say genes provide, in contrast to what evolutionary psychology sometimes implies?
options: Only a basic framework, not absolute instructions for behavior
Complete and unchangeable instructions for every behavior
No influence at all on human behavior
Instructions that only apply to physical, not psychological, traits

questions.prompt: What risk does the text warn that genetic/biological determinism can lead to?
options: It can be misused to justify gender bias
It always leads to greater gender equality
It has no relation to social attitudes
It is only used in medical research, never in social debates

questions.prompt: What does the text suggest is needed to properly understand human psychology, instead of a single-dimension explanation?
options: An integration of biological and sociocultural perspectives
A complete rejection of biology in favor of culture alone
A complete rejection of culture in favor of biology alone
Reliance on a single definitive experiment to settle the debate

questions.prompt: According to the text, what problem can result from sample selection bias in evolutionary psychology studies?
options: It leads to misleading conclusions
It has no effect on research validity
It only affects studies conducted before modern times
It always favors the null hypothesis

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
